500704.name: Rišňovce

500941.name: Výčapy-Opatovce

501034.name: Bajč
501034.note: The website's 2022 elections page was archived only on 2022-06-29 (before the okrsky were set; it then held one unrelated scan) and is gone live; no 2022 notice-board item about the okrsky is archived or live (the live notice board starts in 2023). 501174.name: Iža

The January 2023 referendum's document has only 1 okrsok, so it cannot stand in.

501182.name: Kameničná

The referendum 2023 page has no okrsky document either.

501239.name: Marcelová
501239.note: No 2022 document of the okrsky found: the archived 'Voľby 2022' pages hold only the announcement of the elections and the voting-rights information, the live notice board (searched for okrsk/volebn/miestnost, notice ids 975–1080 of 2022) has no okrsky notice of 2022. 501395.name: Bátorove Kosihy

501425.name: Zlatná na Ostrove

501573.name: Gabčíkovo

Web searches found nothing.

501581.name: Holice

501735.name: Lehnice

501743.name: Lúč na Ostrove

501808.name: Nový Život

501824.name: Okoč
501824.note: The 2022 elections article on okoc.sk (Spojené voľby 2022 / Výsledky volieb, as archived 2022-07-04 and 2022-11-26) attaches only the voter information, the election announcement, candidate lists and results, no okrsky document; the referendum 2023 article only a postal-vote notice; the notice board as archived holds no okrsky document; web searches found none. Not found.

501859.name: Orechová Potôň

501921.name: Topoľníky

502006.name: Vrakúň

Štefana 474/1, without saying which addresses belong to which; no split by parts can be inferred (both stations in one building).

502324.name: Hronovce

502421.name: Kozárovce

502642.name: Plášťovce

504068.name: Tešedíkovo

504122.name: Veľká Mača

504351.name: Gbely

504742.name: Radošovce

504769.name: Rohožník

506991.name: Drahovce

507121.name: Chtelnica

507288.name: Madunice

Hviezdoslava 368/8) without territory, and the obec has a single part, so no part-per-station inference is possible.

507601.name: Špačince
507601.note: The elections 2022 page (archived 2022-10-23 and 2022-11-26, and live) and the notice board as archived on 2022-10-23 (items from 11.1.2022 to 10.10.2022) give only the number of obvody/poslanci, the delegation e-mail, the MVK recorder, the candidate lists and later the results; no okrsky or polling-station document is posted. The 'Referendum 2023' menu item links only to minv.sk. The captured late-2022 files are unrelated (1730460 is a ZlatyErb article). Web searches found nothing.

507709.name: Veľké Kostoľany
507709.note: The live site has only the 2026 elections and referendum pages; the archived 'Voľby' page (Aug 2022, Feb 2023) holds only old candidate lists, the notice board as archived on 2.10.2022 has no elections item, and the 2022 CDX has no elections document. The obec's newsletters 2 and 3/2022 do not mention okrsky. Web search found nothing.

507750.name: Vrbové
507750.note: The 2022 document (Č.j. 1/2022 of 08.08.2022, Hlásenie okrskov, uploaded 2022-08-11 as /wp-content/uploads/2019/02/Volebné-okrsky.pdf) and the referendum 2023 one list only the 4 polling stations (I. ZŠ Školská, Gymnázium, II. ZŠ Komenského left/right); no streets. Vrbové has one part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred. Street lists exist only for 2026 (not used).

507849.name: Budmerice
507849.note: The 2022 elections page (volby-2022-0.html, which a search engine still lists with a file 'Volebné okrsky a volebná miestnosť.pdf') is gone (404) after the website's relaunch, and the relaunched notice board only goes back to 2025. The Internet Archive has no snapshot of that page or of any Budmerice content page between June 2022 and January 2023 (only homepage captures that redirect to the April 2022 copy); its 2023 captures are of 2023 notices. The municipal newsletter has no issue for autumn 2022. No 2022 okrsky document or 2023 referendum document could be found.

507890.name: Gajary
507890.note: The 2022 elections page (live site answers HTTP 429; archived 2023-03-16) has a 'Volebné okrsky' section giving only the number of okrsky (2) and their polling stations (OkVK č. 1 Obecný úrad Gajary – prízemie vpravo, č. 2 prízemie vľavo, both Hlavná 67/105), no streets; the 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb' (4.10.2022) is a blank per-voter template. Gajary is one part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

508012.name: Kostolište
508012.note: Document found: "Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností" of 10.8.2022 (https://www.kostoliste.sk/e_download.php?file=data/editor/93sk_8.pdf&original=Ur%C4%8Denie%20volebn%C3%BDch%20okrskov%20a%20miestnost%C3%AD.pdf). It splits the village by landmarks: okrsok 1 "Hlavná ulica smerom od Malaciek po križovatku smerom Gajary – Jakubov, Hliníky, Stružka, Baráky, za kostolom, k cintorínu smer odpadový dvor"; okrsok 2 "od križovatky smerom Jakubov a Gajary, Alej Martina Benku, Malý Lázok, Šutrovňa, pod lesom". Only Ulica Martina Benku is a register street; 664 of 829 addresses have no street (súpisné only) and the document gives no house numbers, so the split cannot be written as rules without guessing house locations relative to the crossroads. Needs manual mapping.

508021.name: Kuchyňa
508021.note: The current website (new CMS) has no 2022 elections or referendum 2023 pages; the old site's 'Voľby do orgánov samosprávy' page was archived only up to 2021-12 (2018 documents) and its úradná tabuľa only to 2022-03; nothing of the 2022 elections or the 2023 referendum is archived. Web search found no document.

508136.name: Nová Dedinka
508136.note: Both 2022 notices (29.7.2022 and 3.8.2022) give only the polling rooms, both in Základná škola Hlavná 45 (okrsok 1 trieda vpravo, okrsok 2 trieda vľavo), with no territory; the stations are not in different parts, so nothing can be inferred.

508276.name: Tomášov
508276.note: The elections page lists the 2022 documents (počet obvodov a poslancov 15.7.2022, zapisovateľ, delegovanie, results) but no okrsky document; the Internet Archive has none either. The referendum 2023 decision (SKR-499/2022, 14.11.2022) only names the polling stations: okrsok 1 Kultúrny dom Malá sála, okrsok 2 Kultúrny dom Veľká sála, both in the same building, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

508306.name: Viničné
508306.note: No okrsky document for 2022 found. archiv.vinicne.sk is the old WordPress site whose content ends in 2019 (its 'určenie okrskov a miestnosti' is of the 2019 presidential election, not valid). The live 'Voľby a Referendum' page lists only 2026 documents. The Internet Archive's 2022 snapshots of www.vinicne.sk (homepage 2022-09-11) link only the 'Informácia o podmienkach práva voliť' notices; no okrsky notice or elections page of 2022 was archived. Web searches found nothing.

508349.name: Vysoká pri Morave
508349.note: The 2022 decision (8. 8. 2022, Voľby/2022) and the referendum 2023 decision (8. 11. 2022) give only the polling stations: okrsok 1 Hlavná 185/91 (malá sála), okrsok 2 Hlavná 185/91 (veľká sála), both in the same building; no streets or parts. The council resolution 346/40/3/2022 only sets 2 okrsky. The municipality has one part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

508659.name: Hrochoť
508659.note: The 2022 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (03.08.2022, image 219sk_8.jpg) only names the polling stations: okrsok 1 Obecný úrad, Nám. A. Sládkoviča 343/1; okrsok 2 Pizzeria Prego – areál športového klubu, Hlavná ulica 168/21. No streets per okrsok; the obec has one part, so no territory can be given (voters 968/218 suggest okrsok 2 is a small area around the sports grounds, but which streets is unknown). The referendum 2023 document (10.11.2022) is the same.

508675.name: Brusno
508675.note: The 2022 website (WordPress, replaced in 2023) as archived in Aug–Nov 2022 has no elections or referendum okrsky document on its notice board or pages; the current website shows only 2026 documents (and rate-limited further browsing, HTTP 429). Web searches found nothing. The okrsky most likely follow the parts (Brusno / Ondrej nad Hronom), but no document says so.

508900.name: Polomka
508900.note: The 2022 document (Vytvorenie volebných okrskov…, 01.08.2022, archived) only says three okrsky are created, all voting in the Základná škola, Komenského 34; it gives no streets or parts. The referendum 2023 notice likewise. All three okrsky share one polling station, so they cannot be inferred from stations. No 2022 list of streets per okrsok found.

509001.name: Slovenská Ľupča
509001.note: The 2022 elections post has only the council resolution, population and the obvod notice, no okrsky. The referendum's 'Referendum 2023 – utvorenie volebných okrskov, určenie volebných miestností' (9.11.2022) gives the 3 okrsky only one polling station each (ZŠ Sama Cambela, Školská 399/14), no streets. The okrsky's streets appear only in documents of later votes (2023, 2024), which are not used. Internet Archive has nothing of the site for 2022.

509159.name: Čierne
509159.note: The 2022 'Informácia – volebné okrsky' (27.07.2022) and the referendum's (10.11.2022) give only the 3 polling stations (KD Ústredie 189, PD Svrčinovec 963, ZŠ VK 969), no streets or house numbers; Čierne has one part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

509213.name: Klokočov
509213.note: The 2022 document 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov a ich umiestnenie' (8.7.2022) gives each of the 3 okrsky only a name and polling station: č. 01 Klokočov (obecný úrad, 1164), č. 02 Klokočov – Klin (hasičská zbrojnica, 965), č. 03 Klokočov – Hlavice (obecná bytovka, 1082). The obec has 9 parts (Hlavice, Hrubý Buk, Javorová, Klin, Klokočov, Kornica, Riečky, Rybárie, Vrchpredmier), so the okrsky cannot be assigned part by part; the referendum page has no okrsky document.

509230.name: Korňa
509230.note: The 2022 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov a ich umiestnenie' gives only the 3 polling stations (kinosála OÚ; Kultúrny dom prízemie; Kultúrny dom poschodie), all in the same building area, with no territory; 3 okrsky vs 2 parts, so the okrsky cannot be inferred. No referendum document archived.

509248.name: Krásno nad Kysucou
509248.note: The 2022 decision (01.07.2022, https://www.mestokrasno.sk/files/attachments/utvorenie-volebnych-okrskov-2022.pdf) and the referendum 2023 one give only the 6 polling stations (ZŠ Michalkov, ZŠ Kalinov, MsÚ, ZŠ Struhy, ZUŠ, obchod Zákysučie), no streets or parts; 6 okrsky vs 4 parts, so the parts cannot be inferred from the stations.

509264.name: Kysucký Lieskovec
509264.note: Every file of the 'Voľby 2022' page was checked on the live site: subor/23589 'oznámenie.pdf' is the notice on submitting candidate lists (not the okrsky); the others (docx 'Spojené voľby sa budú konať 29. októbra', 'Dôležité informácie k vyhláseným voľbám' stating only 'Počet okrskov: 2', population, decision) define no okrsky. The referendum 2023 'Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov' (9.11.2022) gives only the polling stations (okrsok 1: kultúrny dom, č. 29; okrsok 2: ZŠ, č. 208) without the houses of each okrsok; the municipality has one part, so no part can be inferred. An older article says the village was split by súpisné čísla, but gives no 2022 numbers.

509302.name: Nesluša
509302.note: The 2022 elections page only gives the council's resolution (1 obvod, 2 okrsky). The notice-board PDFs VV2022001–VV2022150 contain no okrsky announcement for the elections; the referendum 2023 notice (VV2022147) only names the polling stations (no. 1 Hasičská zbrojnica Nesluša 532, no. 2 ZŠ Nesluša 837) without territory. The obec has one part and no streets, so the split cannot be inferred. The Internet Archive's 2022 captures of neslusa.sk hold no okrsky document either.

509337.name: Olešná
509337.note: The 2022 document ("Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov a volebných miestností pre voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí a pre voľby do orgánov samosprávnych krajov 29. októbra 2022", undated) gives each okrsok only its polling station: okrsok 1 the Obecný úrad Olešná č. 493, okrsok 2 the Základná škola s MŠ Olešná č. 464; no territory. The referendum's document is the same. The municipality has one part (Olešná, addresses without streets), so the stations cannot stand for parts; no document says which houses vote where.

509477.name: Stará Bystrica
509477.note: The 2022 decision (starosta, 9 August 2022) creates 2 okrsky but gives only their polling stations, both in the same building (Základná škola Stará Bystrica, classrooms 1.B and 1.A); it says nothing of which streets, parts or houses vote in each, so the split cannot be inferred (parts Lány and Stará Bystrica do not correspond to separate stations).

509485.name: Staškov
509485.note: No okrsky document of the 2022 elections found (the 2022 elections page holds only the announcement and voting-right notices; none in the Internet Archive). The referendum's "Informácia – volebné okrsky" (11.11.2022) only says okrsok 1 is "Vyšný koniec obce Staškov" and okrsok 2 "Nižný koniec obce Staškov", both in the Obecný úrad building; the village has no streets, and no boundary or house numbers are given, so it cannot be transcribed without guessing.

509493.name: Svrčinovec
509493.note: The 2022 document exists (https://www.svrcinovec.sk/evt_file.php?file=13818, 08.07.2022, linked from the archived page above) but splits the obec only by named settlements (osady), none of which is a street, part or k.ú. in the register (one part, all 1046 addresses without a street): okrsok 001: U Jurištov, U Skorky, U Mišov, U Katraka, U Hlavača, U Švolka, U Cyprichov; okrsok 002: U Kupky, Pod bučky a valy, U Vajdíka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka, U Matiaška, U Blažkov, Pod grapami, U Puraša, U Privarčáka; okrsok 003: U Liščáka, Škradne, Potok - Bordža. Polling stations: Kultúrny dom; Základná škola; Kaplnka na Závrší. The okrsky cannot be written as rules over the register's addresses without the settlements' house numbers or boundaries.

509523.name: Zákopčie
509523.note: No 2022 elections okrsky document on the website or in the Internet Archive (its 2022 captures hold the election announcement, e-mail address and results, not the okrsky). The referendum's document (9.11.2022) only names two polling stations, both in the obecný úrad (zasadačka; kancelária č. 1), without streets or parts; with 6 parts and 2 okrsky the okrsky cannot be inferred.

509531.name: Zborov nad Bystricou
509531.note: The 2022 decision (Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností, 10.7.2022, https://www.zborovnadbystricou.sk/images/stories/2022/volby/urcenie_volebnych_okrskov_a_volebnych_miestnosti.pdf) names the okrsky only "Volebný okrsok č. 1 – Dolný koniec" and "Volebný okrsok č. 2 – Horný koniec", both in the sála obecného úradu č. 223; it gives no house numbers or boundary, and the register has no streets or parts to tell the two ends apart, so no rules can be written.

509795.name: Liesek
509795.note: The 2022 elections page (Volebné okrsky, zverejnené 23.8.2022) gives only the two polling rooms (sála / prísalie kultúrneho domu), no territory; one part vs 2 okrsky. The referendum 2023 document (download_file_f.php?id=1765555, published 14.11.2022) splits the village vaguely: okrsok 1 'od ulice Staničnej a ulice Priečnej smerom na dolný koniec obce', okrsok 2 'smerom na horný koniec obce'; it does not say which side Staničná/Priečná themselves and the long cross streets (Oravická, Nová, Školská, A. Bernoláka) belong to, so it was not transcribed (and an elections document exists).

509809.name: Lokca
509809.note: No 2022 elections okrsky document on the website (the notice-board files of July–October 2022 that remain are other election notices) or in the Internet Archive. The referendum 2023 document (V Lokci 09.11.2022) only names the polling stations: okrsok 1 sála kultúrneho domu, okrsok 2 prístavba kultúrneho domu, Trojičné námestie 3/8 — same building, one part — so the okrsky cannot be inferred. (The 2026 document splits by streets, but is of a later election.)

509884.name: Novoť
509884.note: No 2022 okrsky document with territory found. The council's resolution 768/2022 (24.6.2022, archived) only says 3 okrsky will be set (2663 voters); the 2022 okrsky decision itself is neither on the current website nor in the Internet Archive. The referendum 2023 decision (10.11.2022) and later ones (NR SR 2023) give the 3 okrsky only with their polling station, all in the same building (sála KD Novoť 285 / ZŠ Novoť 315), so no part or street can be inferred (the village is one part, without streets; the split is by an unknown key).

509906.name: Oravská Lesná
509906.note: The 2022 notice 'Volebné miestnosti – volebné okrsky 2022' (published 10.8.2022, archived 7.10.2022) only says the municipality has 2 okrsky, both with their polling station in the kultúrny dom; it gives no territory of either okrsok. The referendum's notice (2023) says the same. Both stations are in one building, so no part can be inferred per station; no other 2022 document on the okrsky was found on the website, in its WordPress media library or in the Internet Archive; a web search found nothing.

509914.name: Oravská Polhora
509914.note: The 2022 notice (Volebné okrsky.pdf, zverejnené na úradnej tabuli 03.08.2022) only says 3 okrsky are formed and gives each its polling room (1: Gajdošské centrum miestnosť 01; 2: Gajdošské centrum miestnosť 02; 3: Zasadačka OcÚ), with no territory; the obec has a single part, so no part-per-station inference is possible. The referendum 2023 notice (10.11.2022) likewise names only rooms. No other okrsky document among the archived notice-board files of 2022.

510327.name: Bobrovec
510327.note: The 2022 decision (Rozhodnutie o určení volebného okrsku…, V Bobrovci 04.08.2022, archived) only "určuje a zriaďuje 2 volebné okrsky na území obce Bobrovec" with one polling station (Základná škola, Bobrovec č. 490) for both, without saying which houses vote in which okrsok; the referendum 2023 decision (09.11.2022) is worded the same. The register has no streets and one part, so no split can be written.

510785.name: Lisková
510785.note: The 2022 document (10.08.2022) only states 2 okrsky with both polling stations in the ZŠ s MŠ, Ulica pod Chočom 550; no territory of the okrsky. One part only. web.archive.org was unreachable (connection refused) during the search, so no 2022 snapshots could be checked.

510815.name: Lúčky
510815.note: The 2022 document and the referendum 2023 one only state 2 okrsky, both voting in the Obecný úrad Lúčky 141; no territory. One part only.

511129.name: Važec
511129.note: The 2022 announcement 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (archived article 381sk) gives only the two polling stations (both in the Obecný úrad, Na Harte 19), not which streets vote where; Važec has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred. No referendum 2023 okrsky document found on the website or in the archive.

511471.name: Kalinovo
511471.note: No 2022 elections okrsky document found (live site shows only 2026; archived 2022 files are information sheets and the obvod notice). The referendum document of 09.11.2022 only says 2 okrsky were created, both voting in the Základná škola, SNP 20 — no streets or parts, and one station for both, so nothing can be inferred.

511510.name: Látky
511510.note: No 2022 document of the okrsky found, live or in the Internet Archive (only the oznámenie o volebnom obvode and počte poslancov, and a links docx). The referendum 2023 notice (10.11.2022) formed only 1 okrsok, which does not match the 2 okrsky of the elections, so it cannot stand in.

511731.name: Podkriváň
511731.note: The 2022 elections pages (live and archived 2022-08-09) list only the announcement of the elections, voting information, the 'Informácie k voľbám' sheet (1 obvod, 7 poslancov, no okrsky) and candidate notices; the referendum 2023 page lists only the president's decision. No document of the okrsky (2022 elections or the 2023 referendum) found; web searches also found none.

511927.name: Trebeľovce
511927.note: No 2022 (or referendum 2023) okrsky document found: the live site shows only 2026; the archived 2022 homepage (22.10.2022) carries only older notices (2014 and 2015/2016: okrsok 1 Trebeľovce incl. Dolná Bába, 2 Muľka, 3 Láza). Those older okrsky fit the 2022 voters (383/103/240) but are not a 2022 document, and Láza is not a part in the register (it lies in the part Trebeľovce), so it would need a location split anyway.

512354.name: Kláštor pod Znievom
512354.note: No document of the 2022 elections dividing the two okrsky was found: the notice board (live, back to early 2022) has no okrsky notice for 2022, the news post of 27.10.2022 only says both okrsky vote in the ZŠ F. Hrušovského, and the referendum 2023 notice's attachment gives only the polling station of okrsok 1. The Internet Archive keeps nothing more. The parts (Lazany 146 addresses) do not fit the voters (731/688), so no part split can be inferred. A web search found nothing more.

512966.name: Dolná Mariková
512966.note: Found an undated 'Informácie pre voličov' for 29.10.2022 (okrsok 1: časť Dolná Mariková od Adámkov, Ústredie, smer Besné a časť Besné a občania prihlásení na pobyt na obec; okrsok 2: časť Dolná Mariková od ČOV až na Paseky, pod Krápkou, Kátlina a Hadoše), but it has no decision date, the page shows no posting date and web.archive.org was unreachable to date it; besides, it splits the part Dolná Mariková (535 addresses) by local names the register cannot express. Usable as Besné→1, Kátlina+Hadoše→2 if a dated copy turns up.

513008.name: Domaniža
513008.note: The 2022 decision ('Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností … v roku 2022', linked from the obec's Voľby 2022 page) creates 2 okrsky but gives only their polling stations, both in the same building (Materská škola Domaniža, Domaniža 419); it does not say which houses or parts vote in each, so the split cannot be inferred (voters 705/664 do not match the parts Domaniža 504 / Kardošova Vieska 51 addresses). The live site answered HTTP 429 throughout; the document was read from the Archive.

513253.name: Košeca
513253.note: The 2022 decision (2.8.2022) and the referendum's (8.11.2022) give only polling stations: okrsky 1 and 2 both in the ZŠ Školská 243/1, okrsok 3 in the Osvetová beseda, Za parkom 781/25, Košeca – Nozdrovice. Three okrsky vs two parts and no streets, so the split of okrsky 1 and 2 cannot be inferred.

513300.name: Lazy pod Makytou
513300.note: The 2022 document (Volebné obvody, volebné okrsky a volebné miestnosti … 29. októbra 2022, archived docx) gives only the stations: okrsok 1 the Základná škola Lazy pod Makytou, okrsok 2 the Požiarna zbrojnica v Dubkovej. The school (Lazy pod Makytou 148) lies in the register's part Dubková, as does the fire station, so the two stations are not in different parts and no part-per-station split can be inferred (voters 223/804 would also fit okrsok 1 = Dubková, against the document's second station 'v Dubkovej').

513598.name: Pruské
513598.note: No document of the 2022 elections (nor of the January 2023 referendum) found. The official site www.obecpruske.sk now shows only the 2026 elections; its 2022 elections page (volby-do-organov-samospravy-obci-a-volby-do-organov-samospravnych-krajov.phtml?id3=161042, linked from the homepage snapshots of 2022-07-08 and 2022-09-28) was reused for later votes and the live URL now redirects to the 2026 page. The Internet Archive has no 2022 capture of that page (CDX prefix listing of /volby*, availability API empty) and no capture of the notice board or of any election file after March 2022; between July 2022 and January 2023 it holds only the homepage (2022-07-08, 2022-09-28, neither naming the okrsky) and style/image files. The page's archived 2023-07-12 version gives the okrsky of the NR SR elections of 30.9.2023 (okrsok 1: miestna časť Pruské súp. č. 1–335 and voters registered only to the obec; okrsok 2: Pruské súp. č. 336–900, Podvažie, Savčina), a later vote, not used. Three web searches found nothing for 2022. Earlier attempts had the archive answering 'Temporarily Offline'; the CDX and snapshot requests above later succeeded.

513911.name: Bystričany
513911.note: The 2022 document (02.08.2022) gives only the two polling stations (okrsok 1: Obecný úrad, Mirka Nešpora 1/17; okrsok 2: Kultúrny dom, Dlhá 328/16), both in the part Bystričany, with no streets or parts per okrsok; the obec has three parts (Bystričany, Chalmová, Vieska), so the okrsky cannot be inferred. The referendum 2023 page names a single okrsok document (urcenie_volebneho_okrsku.pdf), not the two okrsky. Web archive was temporarily offline during the search.

513989.name: Dolné Vestenice
513989.note: File id 1757470 is 'Výsledky volieb do orgánov samosprávy obcí, 29. 10. 2022' (results, not okrsky). The site was rebuilt; its current elections page and notice board show only 2026 items. The archived homepage of 2022-12-07 lists the notice 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností - Referendum 21. 1. 2023' (id_ci=433429), but the archive has no capture of it and the old URL is 404 live. No 2022 elections okrsky notice was captured (no archive captures of the notices between April and December 2022). Web searches found nothing.

514136.name: Lehota pod Vtáčnikom
514136.note: The 2022 document (Volebne-okrsky.pdf, starosta 12. 7. 2022) gives each of the 3 okrsky only its polling station (1: Obecný úrad, Námestie SNP 34/3; 2: nová ZŠ, Školská 766/2; 3: Klub dôchodcov v hornej časti obce, Jilemnického 876/2), no streets or parts; 3 okrsky but only 2 parts (Malá Lehota, Veľká Lehota), so no part-per-station inference is possible. 514209.name: Nedožery-Brezany

529222.name: Vechec
529222.note: The 2022 decision (10.08.2022) only states that 2 okrsky were created, both voting in the same room (Obecný úrad, Hlavná 133/32 - sála OcÚ); no streets or parts. One part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred. (The official site is obecvechec.sk; vechec.sk is a history site.)

529265.name: Zámutov
529265.note: The 2022 document (Utvorenie volebných okrskov…, 10.08.2022) gives only the two polling stations (1: Komunitné centrum, Zámutov 41; 2: Základná škola, Zámutov 531) and no house numbers or areas; the obec has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

529401.name: Bratislava-Devín
529401.note: The 2022 documents existed on the old website (volby.html, as archived 17.4.2023, links 'Rozhodnutie o utvoreni okrskov a urceni volebnych miestnosti' download_file_f.php?id=1722486 and 'Zoznam volebných okrskov a prislúchajúcich ulíc mestskej časti Bratislava - Devín' id=1725149), but neither file was archived by the Internet Archive and both return 404 on the current website (new CMS shows only 2026 documents). The referendum 2023 okrsky document (id=1764348) is likewise neither live nor archived. Web searches found nothing else.

542717.name: Bojná
542717.note: No okrsky document of 2022 or of the January 2023 referendum: the live elections pages hold for 2022 only the e-mail address for delegating committee members (2.8.2022) and for the referendum only voter information; the notice board shows only current items; the Internet Archive has no Bojná election pages or files of 2022; two web searches found nothing.

543004.name: Chynorany
543004.note: The notice archive (úradné oznamy, Dec 2021 – Jul 2023) has no 2022 elections okrsky notice; the Internet Archive has no 2022 page of chynorany.sk besides assets. The referendum notice 'Referendum - 21.1. 2023 /základné informácie/' (zverejnené 9.11.2022, aktualizované 2.12.2022) says only: 'V obci Chynorany boli utvorené 2 volebné okrsky a určené 2 volebné miestnosti: Okrsok č. 1: Katolícky dom, Továrenská 503/2, Chynorany; Okrsok č. 2: Katolícky dom, Továrenská 503/2, Chynorany' — both stations in the same building and the obec has a single part, so no split can be inferred; its attachments are no longer online. Web searches found nothing.

543322.name: Margecany
543322.note: The 2022 decision (13.7.2022) only creates okrsky č. 1 and č. 2 with polling rooms 102 and 109 in the same obecný úrad building; no streets or parts. One part (Margecany), so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

543331.name: Markušovce
543331.note: The 2022 notice (vyvesené 10. 8. 2022) links "Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností.pdf" (obsah1910_4.pdf), which the Internet Archive did not capture and the new website no longer has. The referendum's document (9.11.2022) forms a single okrsok, so it cannot stand in for the 3 okrsky.

543373.name: Nálepkovo
543373.note: The 2022 document (Oznámenie of 10.8.2022, archived 2022-10-02) only says the mayor forms two okrsky with one common polling station (zasadacia miestnosť OcÚ, Stredný riadok 384/1) for okrsky 1 and 2; it does not say which streets/parts belong to which okrsok, and one station for both cannot be mapped to parts. No referendum 2023 document found in the archive; the live site has only the 2026 documents.

543519.name: Rudňany
543519.note: The 2022 document (Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností, 25.07.2022) gives only the stations (okrsok 1 jedáleň ZŠ s. č. 96, okrsok 2 spoločenská sála obecného úradu s. č. 234), in the obec's one part with no streets; it does not say which houses vote where.

543535.name: Slovinky
543535.note: The 2022 notice (úradná tabuľa, vyvesené 4. 8. 2022) gives each of the 2 okrsky only its polling station (1: Kultúrny dom Slovinky, Slovinky 58; 2: Komunitné centrum Slovinky – Osvetová beseda, Slovinky 379), no territory; the obec has a single part, so no part-per-station inference is possible (the k.ú. Nižné/Vyšné Slovinky are not named). The referendum 2023 notice likewise gives only stations.

543802.name: Streda nad Bodrogom
543802.note: The 2022 document (Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností, 02.08.2022) gives only the polling stations (okrsok 1 Hlavná 390/176, Pamätná budova pri kaštieli; okrsok 2 Hlavná 217/127, kultúrny dom), both on Hlavná in the one part of the obec; it does not say which streets vote where. The referendum page has no okrsky document.

543951.name: Vojčice
543951.note: The 2022 elections' okrsky document is no longer on the official website (its elections page now holds the 2026 documents) and was not archived in 2022. The referendum 2023 document (OCU-446/2022-004, 10 November 2022) gives only the polling stations (okrsok 1: ZŠ, Školská 286/2; okrsok 2: KD, P. O. Hviezdoslava 408/1) without streets; the municipality has one part, so no part can be inferred.

544094.name: Bystré
544094.note: The 2022 notice 'Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestnosti … 29.10.2022' (posted 09.08.2022) is listed on the archived page, but its attachment (files/2022-08-09-081257-DOC116.pdf) is gone from the website and was never archived; the referendum's page has no attachment. No other 2022 document found.

544116.name: Čaklov
544116.note: The 2022 document 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí a volieb do orgánov samosprávnych krajov v roku 2022' (dokumenty/2022/okrsky.pdf) is no longer on the redesigned website, and the Internet Archive's only copy is truncated at 1 MiB (a scan of 1.38 MB): the readable top of the page only creates 2 okrsky (č. 1 Kultúrny dom, č. 2 Školská jedáleň pri MŠ); whatever assigns addresses to them is in the lost part. The referendum's organisational document is truncated the same way. The obec has no streets and one part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

545686.name: Melčice-Lieskové
545686.note: The 2022 announcement 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (04.08.2022, scanned) gives only the polling stations of the 3 okrsky (obecný úrad č. 119; Vila Ecollé, former school Melčice-Dolina č. 175; budova Svadobka č. 444), no streets or parts. 3 okrsky vs 2 parts (Melčice, Zemianske Lieskové): cannot infer.

555576.name: Trhová Hradská
555576.note: The current website starts in 2023. The archived 2022 site (homepage of 23 Oct 2022) shows the 2022 election notices (počet obyvateľov, zapisovateľ, volebný obvod, candidates) but no okrsky announcement; none archived in the CDX. No referendum 2023 okrsky document either.

555754.name: Matúškovo
555754.note: No okrsky announcement among the archived 2022 election notices. The only description is the voters' notice 'Voľby 2022 – Választások 2022' (posted 20. 10. 2022): okrsok 1 for citizens living on the left side of the village in the direction from Galanta, okrsok 2 on the right side. The obec has no streets in the register (súpisné numbers only), so this cannot be written as rules.

555878.name: Horná Kráľová
555878.note: The 2022 documents (council resolution 367-II.-OZ/2022 of 16.06.2022 and the municipal newsletter Kráľovské zvesti 2/2022) only say there are 2 okrsky with polling stations in the Obecný úrad (okrsok 1) and the Základná škola (okrsok 2); no document assigns streets to them. The municipality has one part and streets only, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations. No referendum document with the okrsky' territory was found either.

556483.name: Križovany nad Dudváhom
556483.note: The 2022 announcement (Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností, 03.08.2022) only gives the two polling stations (okrsok 1: Kultúrny dom, s.č. 178; okrsok 2: Základná škola s materskou školou, s.č. 250); no streets or house numbers, and the village has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The January 2023 referendum used a single okrsok.

556696.name: Nitrianske Hrnčiarovce
556696.note: The 2022 document (S 2022/00027-1212/2022, 01.08.2022) only states 2 okrsky with both polling stations in the Kultúrny dom; it gives no territory of the okrsky, and the referendum 2023 notice likewise (both in the ZŠ). One part only, so no inference possible.

557293.name: Vlkanová
557293.note: The current website holds only 2026 (and later) election documents; the Internet Archive has no 2022 snapshot of an elections or okrsky page of vlkanova.sk. No 2022 or referendum 2023 okrsky document found.

558320.name: Ivanka pri Nitre
558320.note: The 2022 announcement (https://ivankaprinitre.sk/web/2022/08/10/volby-do-samospravy-obci-2022/, 10.08.2022) gives only the polling stations of the 3 okrsky, all in the same Kultúrny dom, Novozámocká 141/326 (entrances 1, 2 and the wedding room); no streets. The obec has one part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred. No referendum 2023 document with streets found.

580554.name: Čenkovce
580554.note: The live site lists no 2022 elections documents (the old elections page returns 404). The Internet Archive's only snapshot of the 2022 elections page (2022-06-25) predates the okrsky announcement and holds only the June documents; the archived Referendum 2023 page holds the announcement, voter information and a delegation notice (14.11.2022) without okrsky. The October 2022 scan is truncated in the archive. Web searches found nothing.

581020.name: Hrnčiarovce nad Parnou
581020.note: The 2022 document 'Utvorenie volebného okrsku a určenie volebnej miestnosti' creates 2 okrsky but only names their polling room (both in the Kultúrny dom, Farská 37); no streets per okrsok. No other 2022 list found on the website;
